summary: Chat rollover 3 preserved ATTEMPT=1/3 and continued from the validated semantic-parity checkpoint. The native DX11 shared-eye transport now carries exact producer/consumer PID, runGeneration, transport generation, per-slot frame lifetime, producer EVENT fencing and exact consumer ACK retirement. A post-review P0 defect was then fixed: hard ID3D11Query::GetData errors no longer reclaim ProducerPending textures as if GPU work completed; they quarantine the ring until shutdown/recreation. Exact-SHA hosted CI passed across Backend Conversion Gate, normal Build, all OpenXR host/game variants, and HUD Inspector. NativeDrawPathActivationAllowed remains false and no HMD/in-game runtime test was performed.
selected_work: Close the next DX11 activation prerequisite by inheriting the proven run/generation/fence/consumer-ACK lifetime contract in the dormant native shared-eye transport, compile/gate that code in hosted CI, then adversarially review producer-fence failure handling without enabling native draw routing.
